Asha Rao: OrbitBridge partner asked for a compact perf/W verification for marketplace. Core ask: confirm tokens/W and kernel flag compatibility on their 4-node rack. Who can own run matrix and ingestion?
Dmitri Volkov: I can do run matrix. Proposal: variants = [baseline, tokopt, int8, combined]; QPS = [40,80]; 2 repeats, warmup 3m. Keep runs under 10m each.
Liam O'Connor: I'll handle ingestion. Require PDU CSV + node-to-outlet map and signed sha256. I'll provide a small parser and a validation step.
Asha Rao: Acceptance: tokens/W within 10% of our reference; p95 latency <= +6%. If thermal drift shows, capture 15min trace. Also need a short marketplace blurb after we ingest results.
Dmitri Volkov: Run command to give partner: `./run_orbit_bench --model redwood-1.7b --qps 80 --batch 12 --variant combined --warmup 180 --duration 300 --out ./orbit_results.json`
Liam O'Connor: Ingestion spec: CSV cols = timestamp, watts, outlet_id. Normalizer will convert timestamps to UTC epoch ms. Upload path: s3://redwood-partner-ingest/orbitbridge/<run_tag>.zip

bench-bot: Reminder set to follow up at 1799004365 for results ingest.
